title: MCLegacyCraft Resources
body:
****What are these resources?****

This resource pack is designed to complement the modpack, enhancing Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 with a refined visual identity inspired by Legacy Edition aesthetics.

The goal is not to drastically change Minecraft’s original style, but to subtly improve and polish it—bringing smoother visuals, more consistent textures, and a stronger nostalgic atmosphere that feels familiar yet refreshed.

Every texture and visual adjustment is carefully crafted to preserve the essence of classic Minecraft while making the game feel more immersive, cohesive, and visually pleasing on modern versions.

This pack is optimized to maintain high performance while delivering a clean and timeless look that blends seamlessly with the modpack experience.

This resource pack is designed to complement the modpack in Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1, improving textures, UI, and visual elements with a style inspired by Legacy Edition. The goal is to preserve the original essence of Minecraft while achieving a cleaner, more nostalgic, and more consistent look, without affecting game performance and ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience at all times.
